subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 6, 12 and 24 days respectively. They all together will complete the work in:
solution:
**Given**

A complete a work in 6 days

B complete a work in 12 days

C complete a work in 24 days

**Concept**

First find the work done by A, B and C in 1 day. Then, add the one day work of A, B and C.

**Calculation**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/6

work done by B in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by A, B and C in 1 day = (1/6) + (1/12) + (1/24)

⇒ (4 + 2 + 1)/24

⇒ 7/24

Work complete by A, B and C in 24/7 days. i.e. 33over7 days

**∴ They all together will complete the work in 3{3over7} days.**
